_comment: One source of truth for week 5's rubric. The grader scores from this file, the homework's grading table is copied from it, and you can read it. If a number changes it changes HERE first. The graded repo is the PROJECT repo (D1b); the coursework repo is cloned only for the hygiene sweep, which covers both and scores once.

Check1_YourRecordDoesSomething.label: A method of yours moves a fact nothing outside the class can write — and it moves it on THAT record only

Check2_TheRegistryCanFindOne.label: Registry.Find(name) hands back the record itself, not a copy of it

Check3_AndNothingWhenThereIsnt.label: Find hands back null for a name nobody has — no crash, and nothing changed

Check4_AndCanTakeOneOffTheBooks.label: Registry.Remove(name) takes that one record off and says whether it did

Check5_LastWeeksDoorsStillHold.label: Week 4 still holds — no public fields, All() still copies, Topic still says something

repoReachable.label: Public project repo exists at the URL you submitted, and clones

programRuns.label: The program builds and runs without crashing — even when fed nothing but Enter

gitignoreClean.label: bin/ and obj/ tracked in NEITHER repo — the .gitignore holding, in both places

commits.label: 3+ commits on THIS week's branch 👀 (meaningful messages are a judgement call)

mergedPr.label: A second merge commit on main — this week's branch → pull request → merge
